versions.content: If for a dataElement to be sent a SenderComSpec with han- dleOutOfRange = saturate is provided, a range check shall be implemented in the sending component. If the value is out of bounds, the value actually sent shall be set to the lower respectively the upper limit. In case of a composite datatype each composite element whose actual value is out of bounds shall be saturated.
